title: Contact support and practical identifiability of spur gear microgeometry from transmission error
resource_description: Combined evidence includes 1100 selected synthetic stress cases, 3300 final fitting attempts and 300 covariance-pilot attempts. Deeper IID and gain controls have 200 paired seeds. Includes periodic errors, known and estimated covariance, 10000 paired-bootstrap replicates per contrast, residual compatibility scores and noise-free operator transfer. Earlier evidence and all original numerical tables are preserved. No measured waveform validation or full-cycle corner/fillet contact is claimed.
